subtitles.en: We begin this Saturday with tech leading stocks lower heading into a key week for the AI trade and video results following the outsting of CEO Jensen Wong and anthropics highly anticipated

subtitles.en: market debut still ahead of us. More than 20 investment banks including Bank of America working on that offering, the bank assisting with four of the five largest ever US IPOs.
subtitles.zh: 的市场首秀仍在前方。包括美国银行在内的20多家投行参与此次发行，该行协助了美国史上五大IPO中的四个。

subtitles.en: I'm pleased to say that Johnnie goes around a table as the Bank of America CEO, Chairman Brian Moynihan. Brian Good morning. It's good to see you, sir. I know you're working on this deal.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴介绍美国银行CEO兼董事长Brian Moynihan。Brian早上好，见到你真好。我知道你在处理这笔交易。

subtitles.en: Let's just talk about the previous deals as well. Setting the bank up for record-breaking IPOs.
subtitles.zh: 我们也谈谈之前的交易。让该行准备好迎接破纪录的IPO。

subtitles.en: What does that look like internally? Well, it's a lot of work and a lot of enthusiasm, a lot of work.
subtitles.zh: 内部情况如何？嗯，工作量很大，热情也很高，工作量很大。

subtitles.en: We can't talk about current IPOs obviously, but thinking back to once on the screen there, you know, it's a lot of work, a lot of enthusiasm. Getting it all organized, the road trips and everything
subtitles.zh: 显然我们不能谈论当前的IPO，但回想屏幕上的情况，你知道，工作量很大，热情很高。把一切组织好，路演等等

subtitles.en: is a lot of, in calls out to all the advisors and stuff. The team does a great job and we look forward to that happen. How unprecedented, which is the word that gets thrown around a lot,
subtitles.zh: 需要大量工作，给所有顾问打电话等等。团队做得很好，我们期待那发生。多么史无前例，这个词经常被提起，

subtitles.en: but how unprecedented has Capital Market's activity been in the last 12, 18 months?
subtitles.zh: 但过去12、18个月资本市场活动有多史无前例？

subtitles.en: Well, it was up, you know, the Capital Market's activity, when you all get down with the year, be up, you know, a chunk, but it's been very bumpy. And so what's happening today is, you know,
subtitles.zh: 嗯，资本市场活动在上升，到年底会增长一大块，但一直非常波动。所以今天发生的是，你知道，

subtitles.en: right now, as deals are getting pushed into early next year, largely because the uncertainty that underlies, this is a different kind of company, but to run the mill companies,
subtitles.zh: 现在交易被推到明年初，很大程度上因为不确定性，这是一家不同类型的公司，但对于普通公司，

subtitles.en: these are general companies by tech companies, some of the stuff sliding in the next year, the team tells me over the weekend. And it's not because it won't get done, it's just trying to let the market settle in after this major transaction. And we'll see what happens next. So the pipelines
subtitles.zh: 这些是科技公司的一般公司，一些项目将在明年推进，团队周末告诉我。这不是因为无法完成，而是想让市场在这笔重大交易后稳定下来。我们看看接下来会发生什么。所以管道

entities.evidence: Wikipedia and Bank of America investor page confirm he is Chair and CEO of Bank of America; Chinese form 布莱恩·莫伊尼汉 is the standard media rendering but the snippets themselves are English-only, so confidence is medium.
Both sources identify Bank of America and its CEO role; 美国银行 is the established Simplified Chinese name. 美洲银行 is an older/less standard variant.
Multiple Chinese financial sources use the Latin name Anthropic without a Chinese transliteration; no established official Chinese name found.
Transcript says 'Jensen Wong'; public sources name Jensen Huang (黄仁勋) as Nvidia CEO. Chinese form 黄仁勋 is widely established, though the provided snippets are English-only.
Multiple sources identify Nvidia; 英伟达 is the established Simplified Chinese name.
Chinese financial media routinely use IPO alongside 首次公开募股.

clip_research.source_claim: Moynihan says Anthropic's IPO is pushing some deals into early next year, and that more than 20 investment banks including Bank of America are working on the offering.
clip_research.public_baseline: Chinese financial media report Anthropic filed an S-1 and that a 22-bank syndicate led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley is underwriting the Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript frames Anthropic's IPO as a delay factor for other deals, while public coverage emphasizes the scale of the offering itself; the delay framing is the less-covered angle.

evidence.fact: Moynihan: deals getting pushed into early next year largely because of uncertainty; more than 20 investment banks working on Anthropic offering.

具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
